title: Task-Aware Harness Provisioning for LLM Agents in Mission-Critical Infrastructure Operations
abstract: arXiv:2608.17433v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: LLM agents have been widely adopted to operate mission-critical infrastructure (MCI). These agents normally rely on a harness that determines what information they can access, which tools they can use, and what actions they can take. Existing systems often expose the same comprehensive harness to every task, which may not be necessary and cause resource wastes. In this paper, we focus on the identification of optimal harness configurations, and view it as a resource-matching problem between what each task requires and what the harness provides. To measure this match, we classify MCI tasks based on the mathematical representation of the underlying system and rank harness configurations by the amount and type of information they provide. We then construct task-to-harness mappings from two sources: mining research literature and measuring controlled agent execution. Leveraging the measured mapping, we propose a new harness provisioning algo

translated_title: 面向关键基础设施运维中LLM智能体的任务感知工具集配置方法
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型（LLM）智能体已被广泛用于运维关键基础设施（MCI）。这些智能体通常依赖一个工具集（harness），该工具集决定了它们可以访问哪些信息、使用哪些工具以及采取哪些行动。现有系统往往对每个任务暴露相同的全面工具集，这可能并非必要，并导致资源浪费。本文聚焦于识别最优工具集配置，并将其视为任务需求与工具集提供之间的资源匹配问题。为衡量这种匹配，我们基于底层系统的数学表示对MCI任务进行分类，并根据工具集提供的信息类型和数量对配置进行排序。然后，我们从两个来源构建任务到工具集的映射：挖掘研究文献和测量受控智能体执行。利用测得的映射，我们提出了一种新的工具集配置算法。
tldr: 本文提出了一种任务感知的工具集配置算法，通过将MCI任务按数学特征分类并映射到最优工具集，从而减少资源浪费，提升LLM智能体在关键基础设施运维中的效率。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a task-aware harness provisioning algorithm that classifies MCI tasks by mathematical features and maps them to optimal harnesses, reducing resource waste and improving LLM agent efficiency in mission-critical infrastructure operations.
